AQRP_FIXED_REVIEW_SHA: 5262032bee4f631f68763e57510e1878945f6b8c

## Phase5 G1 design revisions — fixed-version independent recheck required
GPT Work audited only `5c9721f96679f4d495b7b3b93af3e2e31e66ae62`: **PLAN BLOCKED / REQUEST CHANGES**, 2 High + 2 Medium OPEN. It observed `bd18d1b98b5647f4f4b6345ffe73dca40acaf038` at close but did not review that newer commit. This candidate is built on bd18d1b. **All four findings remain OPEN_PENDING_GPT_WORK_RECHECK; no independent PLAN PASS or implementation authorization is claimed.**

Scope remains the canonical twelve Phase5 requirements (10 MVP / 2 Competition Ready): BT-001–010, QA-003, INT-002. No P5 business implementation. Released P4 main / phase4-baseline / v0.4.0 remain `32ea5d6b75c84c07017d87377eeabd2f78207c5c`; other branches and all old tags unchanged.

## Four design dispositions
| Finding | Candidate revision | Predeclared reference cases |
|---|---|---|
| WORK-P5-G1-001 High | Outer scheduling envelopes; one latest-state atomic MatchTransaction per order; Fill80/Account90 local child records; commit_seq/child_seq replay; cancellation65/borrow95/valuation100 and pre/post crash boundaries | N01–N03 |
| WORK-P5-G1-002 High | Disjoint C_set / U_free / U_short, S_set only a settled subset; true cash availability avoids double-freezing; P4 budget H explicitly separate from actual cash; short settlement/partial cover/cross-zero/dividends | N04–N11 |
| WORK-P5-G1-003 Medium | Frozen two-sided price domain for every BUY/SELL + MARKET/LIMIT; effective sell price_upper; cumulative paid + all remaining worst-case fees <= registered F; cancel does not refund paid fees | N12–N17 |
| WORK-P5-G1-004 Medium | CLOSED_FIFO_FRAGMENT counting, exact historical-lot commission/borrow/long-dividend/short-payable attribution; cross-zero, partial close, no second rounding, zero/undefined conventions | N18–N25 |

Detailed drafts: `docs/audits/phase-5/EVENT_TRANSACTION_ADDENDUM.md`, `CASH_BUCKETS_AND_PROJECTION.md`, `EXECUTION_PRICE_AND_FEES.md`, `FIFO_ATTRIBUTION.md`. Core interface/math/profile and test/requirement traceability are synchronized.

**C-P5-001 is an explicit proposed clarification/change to the frozen P0 queue/atomic interpretation, not an already approved compatibility claim.** Original BACKTEST_CONTRACT.md remains byte-identical. `CONTRACT_CHANGE_IMPACT.md` records impact and required explicit human acceptance before any implementation. New economic/statistical choices also require later user acceptance. G1 does not authorize implementation, finance or deployment.

## Review entry and original evidence
- `docs/audits/phase-5/REVIEW_PACKAGE_CURRENT.md` — authoritative current recheck entry.
- `g1-5c9721f/received/REPORT.md`, `DEVELOPER_HANDOFF.md`, `FINDINGS.json` — original independent BLOCKED report and controls, unchanged.
- `g1-5c9721f/RECEIVED.json`, `DEVELOPER_RESPONSE.md` — review scope, exact receipt checks and one-to-one disposition.
- Original independent ZIP: 96239761 bytes; SHA256 `60d16ecfe7f7663282506b9c250878c2f3d6fc61e630dbcd656a950c93855075`. CRC / exact246 members / all245 hashes verified. Git is an explicitly declared textual subset; full original ZIP and every prior failure remain externally retained.
- `SUPPLEMENTAL_CANDIDATES.json`, `supplemental_reference_check.py`, `DESIGN_REVISION_IDENTITY.json`, `g1-5c9721f/developer-validation/` — predeclared literal answers, exact identities, actual commands/environment/stdout/stderr.

## Actual developer checks and limits
Original **25 groups / 70 literal assertions** and original checker bytes are unchanged and passed. Supplemental **25 groups / 209 design arithmetic/trace assertions** passed. These are developer design references, **not P5 product tests, actual crash-recovery/native-isolation tests or independent approval**. Source/tests/tools/CI/build/lock, canonical106 catalogue, all131 frozen files and frozen P0/P4 contracts remain unchanged; existing3440-file P4 package checks passed. Secret scan and staged whitespace check passed.

A pre-existing inherited regression was discovered: the earlier deferral commit had prefixed protected `docs/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md`, causing the original strict package check to fail. This candidate restores that file to exact released32ea bytes; the complete user deferral instruction remains in AGENTS and the dedicated deferral record. Initial failure command/raw logs and disposition are retained; no check/expected hash was changed. Only affected static checks were rerun; already passed arithmetic was not repeated. See `developer-validation/PREEXISTING_REGRESSION_DISPOSITION.json`.

No new full SDK or official CI ZIP verification is claimed for P5 implementation. PR CI continues existing P4 regression only. Prior P4 SDK844 / old20+4+91 and R3 SDK681 are historical evidence for their own fixed versions.

## Unchanged authorization and isolation boundaries
Phase5 remains **G1 BLOCKED at the reviewed old SHA / revised candidate pending recheck; implementation NOT AUTHORIZED**. No merge, tags, deployment, real account/ACL/service/scheduler changes, live trading, formal Test, financial approval or P6.
WI-R2-001/002 remain **DEFERRED / NOT VERIFIED**, with full final-integrated40-SHA lifecycle validation and permission plan separately authorized later. R3 code fixes were independently closed at separate PR7 SHA `62074502aa4c32556b5e690bac10bd8054bd9178`, but have not been integrated into this P4-based branch. Code/model/CI passes cannot close native isolation obligations.

Audit the exact full SHA above, not drifting HEAD. Preserve old reports/locks/packages; issue a new independent verdict for this candidate and separately identify any pending human contract/economic decisions.


## Sealed developer handoff for this exact candidate
Fixed SHA remains `5262032bee4f631f68763e57510e1878945f6b8c`. Local review directory: `C:\Users\11638\AppData\Local\AQRP\reviews\p5-g1-repair-5262032`; copy-ready `GPT-Work-G1-Recheck-Instructions.txt`, `Evidence.zip`, `EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json`, `RECEIPT.json`. Outer ZIP: 168344241 bytes; SHA256 `131f02b58473c01bb96e9fb32f59965fe6d72f3a516331984b61614d9addbadc`; 132 declared files plus manifest, CRC/exact members/all hashes reverified. Includes full fixed Git source, current complete P5 plan, original independent G1 ZIP unchanged, code/design diffs, actual design-reference commands/logs and the original static freeze failure/recheck. This is developer evidence, not independent G1 approval, P5 implementation tests or real Windows isolation validation.
